## Symptom

A certificate expired on a test listener and the TLS handshake failed: the same words as a matched lesson, and no match of its own.

## Contributing factor

The test listener is outside the client-side check.

## Root cause

Test listeners are created by hand and never enrolled in the certificate check.

## Open reason

Whether test listeners belong in the check is not decided yet.
